label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input (param from request.getParameter) is directly concatenated into SQL query on line 22 ('UPDATE accounts SET note=' + param + '...'). Query is stored in request attribute and passed to PendingSql.maybeRun() which executes it via st.executeUpdate(sql) when sql.exec.enabled=true. No sanitization or parameterization protects against injection.

evidence.note: SQL query constructed with unsanitized param, then passed to maybeRun for execution
